_comment: XACA-1300-003. Which account each machine's DEFAULT OAuth login is, used ONLY by fleet-monitor's /api/token-reports aggregation to label kb-token-report rows whose account is `default-oauth`. The per-machine records are never rewritten. Keys are the machine's short name (first DNS label of the reporter hostname, lowercased); `aliases` catch the LocalHostName form. default_oauth_account=null means NOT STATED: those rows stay `default-oauth:unmapped`, never guessed. login_hash_observed is sha256[:8] of ~/.claude.json oauthAccount.accountUuid, the same hash kb-token-report records; a record carrying a different hash is labelled `default-oauth:login-changed`, and one login hash stated as two different accounts is labelled `default-oauth:conflict` on every machine involved. Provenance fields say where each value came from; a user-stated account is not a measurement.

darren-m3pro-mbp.provenance: user-stated 2026-09-22 (day to day M3Pro runs on claude-max-me2 through per-team ai.credential routing; that traffic carries its own resolved account, not default-oauth)
